item.title: 당신은 키미 델타(Kimi Delta)를 떠올릴 수도 있었습니다.
item.description:
📝 모든 어텐션 가중치는 스칼라입니다. \lvert o_t\rangle = \sum_{i\leq t} \lvert k_i\rvert q_t\rangle \lvert v_i\rangle. \begin{정렬됨} \lvert o_t\rangle &= \sum_{i\leq t} \lvert v_i\rangle \lvert k_i\rvert q_t\rangle\\ &= \left( \sum_{i\leq t} \lvert v_i\rangle\langle k_i\rvert \right) \lvert q_t\rangle.
🔤 Original: You Could Have Come Up with Kimi Delta Attention
🔗 Read more: https://blog.doubleword.ai/you-could-have-come-up-with-kimi-delta-attention
